about_the_game:
Get ready for the ultimate explosion in PYRO!
Dive into a vibrant 2D pixel art world and discover the Great Fire Castle, a place where fireworks and rockets exist solely to fulfill their purpose: creating the most epic blast in history.

In PYRO, you’ll control different rockets through frantic, action-packed levels. Each rocket has a clear mission: to reach its final destination and deliver an unforgettable explosive show. Can you guide each rocket through its brief but spectacular journey to achieve the perfect KABOOM?

Key Features

  • 2D Platforming Adventure: Jump, dodge, and boost through levels full of dangers and unique challenges.

  • Pixel Art Aesthetic: A retro visual experience blending nostalgia and modernity.

  • Frantic Gameplay: Test your reflexes and precision in levels designed to keep you on edge.

  • Unique Rockets: Each rocket has its own personality, abilities, and explosive desire to fulfill.

  • Spectacular Explosions: Unlock new ways to create blasts and delight your senses with incredible visual and sound effects.

A Game for Everyone
PYRO is a tribute to creativity and explosive spirit. Whether you’re a fan of retro games or seeking something new and thrilling, this title offers fun for every type of player.

Are you ready to become the master of explosions? Download PYRO now and make history in the Great Fire Castle!
